title: Improving Adherence to Guidelines for Empirical Antibiotic Therapy in the Emergency Department Through Structured Training and Pocket Cards—A Before-and-After Study
summary:
The overall objective of this study is to quantify adherence to guidelines for empirical antibiotic therapy and to improve it sustainably through a targeted, multi-stage intervention (training and a pocket card).
This is intended to prevent antibiotic resistance.
conditions: Guideline-Based Prescribing of Antibiotics in the Emergency Department

interventions.name:
Retrospective data analysis of patients treated in the emergency department before and after structured training (intervention) for the treating physicians as part of a quality assurance initiative.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
